author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
Owner-approved architecture proposal — 2026-11-10. Priority P0, subject to existing safety and governance gates.

Separate EMP (Effect Management Protocol) from EAP (Effect Acknowledgement Protocol). EAP independently validates actual effects; EMP orchestrates authorized work to attain them.

Human principal defines desired effect, measurable acceptance predicate, scope, authorization, priority, budget, stop/reversal constraints.

Lifecycle: PROPOSED -> AUTHORIZED -> PLANNED -> EXECUTING -> OBSERVING -> REPAIRING/BLOCKED/VERIFIED/ABORTED. VERIFIED only with independent EAP evidence.

Safety invariants: no effect without authorization; single fenced writer per objective/epoch; durable journal and idempotent replay; no false success; bounded retries; TEMDD on failed CI/CD; preserve independent progress despite blocked dependencies; exact HEAD/TREE, SHA256, review and original-host gates; human revocation and irreversible-action boundaries.

Deliverables: versioned EMP spec and typed objective schema; Lean transition model and safety proofs with implementation binding; durable reference executor and writer fencing; negative tests for unauthorized effects, stale writer, missing ACK, bad hash, CI failure, replay, deadlock, cancellation; end-to-end broken manifest -> repair -> hash readback -> EAP acknowledgement.

Acceptance: demonstrate verified authorized effect or persist precise external blocking condition. No automatic merge without existing governance. No claim EMP implemented, production ready, or EFFECT_ACK_DONE until independently evidenced.
title: [P0] EMP: human-authorized Effect Management Protocol with EAP-verified closed-loop execution
